en.label: English
en.name: Glimmer — Affirmations
en.tagline: A moment of encouragement. Every day.
en.description: Discover daily affirmations, save the words that resonate and make space for your own thoughts.
features: Find words for your day
Explore affirmation topics and keep your favourites close.
Make it personal
Write your own affirmations and choose backgrounds, fonts and colours.
Keep a gentle reminder
Set local reminders and add affirmations to your Home Screen with a widget.
en.documents_intro: The details behind the app, in your language.
en.privacy_note: Your affirmations, favourites and preferences are stored on your device. The app also uses analytics and crash reporting services. Some content was created with the help of AI.
en.content_note: Some in-app content was created with the help of artificial intelligence. Affirmations are for general inspiration and do not replace professional medical or psychological care.
